body: The same scheduling conflict that we've had for the last couple of times is occurring again, but I am told it's (for real!) for the last time. I plan to move this meeting an hour later again to accommodate the several folks who need to be in both meetings, unless a large number of people tell me otherwise.
I'm also interested. No questions this time.

> I'm also interested. No questions this time.

Added, thanks.

Thanks everyone for attending! Here are the notes from this meeting (next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7581):

### Agenda

1. Review past action items
   1. Olli & Anne will send Domenic more info on [popstate/hashchange dispatching doesn't match what browsers do](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/1792).
      1. Domenic [commented](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/1792#issuecomment-1013543589).
      1. Olli [commented.](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/1792#issuecomment-1029242243)
   1. Henri will think a bit more about the parser implications with [adding the `<search>` element](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/7320).
      1. Will revisit in the future, when Henri has thought about this
   1. Mason will review and comment on the [Use the real tokenizer and tree builder for meta scan](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/7205) thread.
      1. Mason [commented](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/7205#issuecomment-1028240528). Will continue discussing asynchronously.
   1. Mason to solicit feedback for [adding a legacy encoding for Azeri](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/7212).
      1. Mason [commented](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/7212#issuecomment-1029232366). Domenic will merge the PR.
1. Carryovers from last time
   1. Tess commented to the [`<input type=password>` should provide UI to show/hide its value](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7293) thread.
      1. Emilio will ping Mats and we'll discuss again in the future.
   1. [Anne] [XML MIME types used for documents are not interoperable](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7420)
      1. Mason and Domenic to discuss Chromium's opinion.
   1. [Mason] [Should 'true' count as truthy in parsing windowFeatures booleans?](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7399)
      1. No objections, Mason will investigate HTTP archive and maybe implement. Let's also investigate "on" and non-1 integers.
   1. [Domenic] [Valid/Invalid characters in document.createElement()](https://github.com/whatwg/dom/issues/849#issuecomment-1007541209)
      1. Olli and Mason to leave feedback on the proposal.
   1. [saschanaz] [Mouse events & disabled form controls](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/2368)
      1. Will discuss it next time. Joey will post an update on the thread.
   1. [Anne] [Meta: Notice: Moving PR6478 to W3C Extension Specification](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7405)
      1. Will discuss it next time.
   1. [Domenic] [:active pseudo-class specification doesn't account for children/labels of disabled form elements](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/6635)
      1. Need to test Safari's behavior. Domenic will investigate.
   1. [Domenic] [Add ability to query UserActivation state](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4008) ([PR](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/4009))
      1. navigator.userActivation: let's do it.
      1. Domenic will discuss postMessage parts with Chromium folks.
1. [Domenic] [URL-bar triggered prerendering](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7533)
   1. Everyone's feedback is encouraged. Olli is positive.
1. [Dominic] [autocomplete attribute for street-address details](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4986)
   1. Olli will ask Mozilla engineers for feedback. Feedback from WebKit is welcome.
1. [Domenic] [blur and change events fire for elements removed from DOM](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/3847)
   1. Emilio and Domenic will investigate further and leave feedback.

### Action Items

1.  @domenic will merge the PR for [adding a legacy encoding for Azeri](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/7212).
1. @emilio will ping @MatsPalmgren on the [`<input type=password>` should provide UI to show/hide its value](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7293) thread.
1. @mfreed7 and @domenic will discuss Chromium's opinion on [XML MIME types used for documents are not interoperable](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7420).
1. @mfreed7 will investigate with the HTTP Archive and maybe implement [Should 'true' count as truthy in parsing windowFeatures booleans](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7399). Will also investigate "on" and non-1 integers.
1. @smaug---- and @mfreed7 will leave feedback on the proposal for [Valid/Invalid characters in document.createElement()](https://github.com/whatwg/dom/issues/849#issuecomment-1007541209).
1. @josepharhar will post an update on the [Mouse events & disabled form controls](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/2368) thread.
1. @domenic will investigate [:active pseudo-class specification doesn't account for children/labels of disabled form elements](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/6635).
1. @domenic will discuss postMessage parts with Chromium folks for [Add ability to query UserActivation state](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4008).
1. Everyone's feedback is encouraged on [URL-bar triggered prerendering](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7533).
1. @smaug---- will ask Mozilla engineers for feedback on [autocomplete attribute for street-address details](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4986). Feedback from WebKit is welcome.
1. @emilio and @domenic will investigate further and leave feedback on [blur and change events fire for elements removed from DOM](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/3847).
